## ✅ Landing — 32/32 green, Clause-② no verified from the diff, ready + auto-merge

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`.

### Checks, read by name

**29 success, 3 skipped by design** (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard …)`) on head `64d8fbe2a`. The long poles: `Test (shard 1/4)` 11:55:07 · `2/4` 11:54:07 · `3/4` 11:53:02 · `4/4` 11:53:32 · `Type Check` 11:47:40 · `Lint` 11:45:03. Also read individually: `Bundle Analysis`, `README Export Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Docs Route Eager Closure Check`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`.

### Landing authority

`Clause-②: no`, **re-derived by this seat from the diff** rather than taken from the declaration — the gate's own rule is 「diff 是事实,卡片语义是预测」. Seven files: two renderer faces, one comment-only app-shell note, three tests, one changeset. Nothing under `packages/spec/**`, no `*.zod.ts`, nothing under `packages/types/src`. ⇒ neither limb fires; this seat lands it without a contract review.

### What I verified by content, not from the report

| probe | `plugin-list/ListView.tsx` | `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `startDateField: … \|\| 'created_at'` | 1 → **0** | 1 → **0** |
| CONTROL `titleField: … \|\| 'name'` (kept on purpose) | 2 → 2 | 3 → 3 |

The control is non-zero and unmoved, so the probe discriminates and the change is surgical.

⚠️ **A probe of mine that was wrong, recorded because it would mislead the next reader too:** a raw word-count of `created_at` in `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx` reads **1 → 1** and looks like the floor survived. It did not — the residual occurrence is inside the *new comment documenting the retirement*. Only the declaration form is an honest probe here. Same class as the tombstone inflation this lane hit earlier today on a different card: count the form, never the word.

The `packages/app-shell` edit was checked to be **comment-only** by filtering the diff for non-comment added/removed lines and getting an empty set — not by trusting the claim. It realigns the #3129 note, which had been certifying the two sibling faces as still-fabricating.

### Why this step matters more than its diff size suggests

#7459 installed `ObjectTimeline`'s refusal and then measured that **nothing began refusing**. This is why: `ObjectTimeline` reads the flat `schema.startDateField` at the tail of its resolver chain, so a floor at either face answered "the axis is bound" for every view and the refusal was unreachable from both routes. The invented axis was also never *fetched* — `$select` is collected from the declared `timeline` blocks, never from this prop — so an undeclared view got a timeline bound to a column the query had not requested and bucketed every record into "No date". A screen that looks built, is wrong, and tells the author nothing.

⭐ The ablation's DOM dump under restored floors is the evidence that matters: `data-testid="timeline-canvas"` rendering `Spring Launch` — a healthy, convincing, entirely wrong timeline, not a crash. That is what the pin has to be able to fail on.

### Two things the implementer did that I want on the record

1. **The first ablation anchor matched two sites** in `ListView.tsx` (the same conditional-spread text also builds `resolvedTimeline`'s nested config, untouched here). The assertion **refused and aborted rather than mutating the wrong line.** That is the protocol catching precisely what it exists to catch; both anchors are now two-line.
2. **`InterfaceListPage:413-414` was reported as a boundary and deliberately NOT filed as a finding.** It derives the binding from `defaultCalendarFromObject(objectDef)` — a field the object *declares*, or `undefined`. Derivation, not fabrication, so it is consistent with 日期轴永不虚构 rather than a surviving instance of it. Naming it is what shows it was measured rather than missed, and it is the one remaining route by which a view that declared no axis still gets one.

### Card state

`Part of #7070` is deliberately **not** a closing keyword — #7070 stays open on flavour 3, now filed as **#7499** (`progress` / `dependencies`, re-measured as surviving at **two** faces, not three; the app-shell face carries neither key). #7070 was also moved `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigned, closing a half-state the implementer correctly reported back instead of writing the assignee field itself.
